description: 夕方の駅のコンコースで、2人の高校生が電車に乗ろうとしているが、男子生徒が財布を見つけられず困っている。左側の男子生徒は開いたバックパックの中を焦った表情で探し、ポケットにも手を入れて財布を確認している。右側の女子生徒は落ち着いて周囲を見回しながら、ベンチの下に落ちている財布を見つけて指さしている。背景には改札口、券売機、駅の時計、電光掲示板、ベンチ、傘、飲み物などがあり、時計から電車の発車時刻が近いことが分かる。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly two Japanese teenage students inside a clean modern railway station concourse in the early evening. There must be exactly two visible people in the entire image: one teenage boy and one teenage girl. Do not include station staff, other passengers, reflected people, silhouettes, advertisements containing human figures, or distant pedestrians. The main story is that the boy cannot find his wallet just before they need to catch a train. On the left side of the foreground, the teenage boy is wearing casual clothes and carrying a backpack. His backpack is open, and he is searching inside it with one hand while checking one of his pockets with the other hand. His facial expression should clearly show worry, confusion, and urgency. Several harmless personal items such as a notebook, earphones, and a small towel are visible inside the open backpack, but the wallet is not inside. On the right side, his teenage female friend is standing calmly beside him and looking around the area. She has just noticed the missing wallet lying partly underneath a nearby station bench. She is pointing clearly toward the wallet with one hand while looking toward the boy, as if trying to tell him that she has found it. The wallet must be clearly visible on the floor beneath the front edge of the bench and should look like the same kind of item the boy is searching for. Create a secondary sense of urgency using environmental details rather than additional people: show a large station clock indicating that departure time is approaching, an electronic departure board with simple train icons and nonessential numbers, closed automatic ticket gates, a ticket machine, railway route map, bench, umbrella stand, reusable drink bottle, and a small shopping bag. A train may be visible through glass or an opening in the distant background, but no driver or passengers should be visible. Make the two actions immediately understandable: the boy anxiously searching for his missing wallet and the girl discovering and pointing toward the wallet under the bench. The emotional contrast should also be clear: the boy looks worried while the girl looks relieved and helpful. Exactly two visible people, no more and no less. No animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters, and no important readable text. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style with realistic proportions, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.
